key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh usage data in seconds

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Icon style: 'color' for the original colored icon, 'monochrome' for a desaturated monochrome icon

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the Claude icon in the top bar

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy URL (e.g., http://localhost:11809). Leave empty to use no proxy.

key.name: show-five-hour-panel-bar
key.description: Whether to show the 5-hour progress bar in the top panel, independent of its percentage text

key.name: show-five-hour-panel-text
key.description: Whether to show the 5-hour percentage text in the top panel, independent of its bar

key.name: show-seven-day-panel-bar
key.description: Whether to show the 7-day progress bar in the top panel, independent of its percentage text

key.name: show-seven-day-panel-text
key.description: Whether to show the 7-day percentage text in the top panel, independent of its bar

key.name: hidden-extra-limits
key.description: JSON array of limit identifiers (from the API's dynamic limits list, e.g. per-model weekly caps) the user has chosen to hide from the dropdown menu

key.name: last-fetch-succeeded
key.description: Whether the most recent usage API call returned 200. Used by prefs to warn if a manual token refresh is unnecessary.

key.name: warn-on-projected-depletion
key.description: Project current burn rate (from usage history) forward; if a limit is on track to hit 100% before its reset time, blink the affected panel bar orange/red or blue/red. Alpha feature — default off.

key.name: refresh-trigger
key.description: Incremented by prefs.js after the manual token-refresh subprocess completes. The running extension watches this key and immediately re-fetches usage instead of waiting for the next poll interval.

key.name: flash-on-refresh
key.description: Briefly flash the panel indicator each time a live usage fetch succeeds, as visual feedback that a refresh just happened

key.name: csv-export-dir
key.description: Directory the user last saved a usage-history CSV export to, remembered across sessions so the save dialog reopens there

key.name: stack-panel-bars
key.description: Whether to stack the 5-hour and 7-day panel bars vertically instead of side by side

key.name: show-bar-labels
key.description: Show a single-letter metric tag (5 = 5-hour, W = 7-day) to the left of each panel bar so the two are distinguishable at a glance. This is the "Show Label" column toggle — one of the four global panel-column toggles (logo/label/bar/percent).

key.name: show-panel-bar
key.description: Global column toggle: whether the progress bar is drawn on every visible metric row in the top panel. Independent of the percent text.

key.name: show-panel-percent
key.description: Global column toggle: whether the percentage text is drawn on every visible metric row in the top panel. Independent of the bar.

key.name: show-five-hour
key.description: Whether the 5-hour metric row appears in the top panel at all. When off, its label/bar/percent are all hidden regardless of the column toggles.

key.name: show-seven-day
key.description: Whether the 7-day metric row appears in the top panel at all. When off, its label/bar/percent are all hidden regardless of the column toggles.

key.name: panel-show-migrated
key.description: Internal: true once the pre-refined per-metric panel visibility keys have been migrated into the global column toggles and per-metric row masters.
